## Analytical code and outputs {#f01-pipeline-review}

This section is the authoritative source review for F01 derivation,
exploration, and candidate fitting. Expand a script or CSV to inspect its
complete contents, read from the repository on every render. Model leaders
remain provisional pending scientific review.

See the [fuel pipeline map](pipeline-fuel.qmd) for execution order and
[RD04's source review](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-source-review) for subsequent inference,
figure/table generation, and historical display implementations.

### Complete F01 scripts

Configuration and model helpers are maintained here with stages 01–05.
RD04 consumes their saved fitted models; rendering this page does not fit them.

### Complete F01 CSV outputs {#f01-csv-review}

Tables preserve every row, column, saved numeric value, and missing-value label.
Wide or long tables scroll; downloads retain the original CSVs.

```{r}
#| label: f01-csv-source-review
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

source("scripts/render-csv-review.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
tasks <- jsonlite::fromJSON("tasks.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
review_task <- Filter(function(task) task$id == "F01", tasks)[[1]]
groups <- c(
  `data` = "Component definitions, pairing, and exploration",
  `manifests` = "Model candidates, registries, and provisional leaders"
)
for (directory in names(groups)) {
  cat("\n#### ", groups[[directory]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  prefix <- paste0("analysis/outputs/publication/fuel/", directory, "/")
  paths <- sort(unlist(review_task$outputs))
  paths <- paths[startsWith(paths, prefix) & endsWith(paths, ".csv")]
  for (path in paths) render_csv_review(path)
}
```
